description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to grain type identification in Orleans. It includes the IGrainTypeProvider interface, a default implementation AttributeGrainTypeProvider, and an attribute class GrainTypeAttribute that associates a grain type string with a class.

classes.name: AttributeGrainTypeProvider
classes.description: Provides grain type information based on attributes applied to classes, using dependency injection through IServiceProvider.

classes.name: GrainTypeAttribute
classes.description: An attribute that can be applied to a class to specify its grain type explicitly.

methods.name: TryGetGrainType
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the grain type for a given class, based on the presence of a relevant attribute.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the grain type associated with the class, as specified by the attribute.
